breville-smart-oven-air-fryer-pro-bov900: Praised for ease of use, solid build and even cooking; cleaning is the biggest complaint.
breville-smart-oven-pro-bov845: Liked for quick preheat, even heating and a sturdy feel; many report the convection fan failing.
breville-sous-chef-16-pro-bfp800: Praised as sturdy and powerful, still going after years; few real complaints.
breville-super-q-bbl920: Liked as quieter than a Vitamix, with smooth, velvety smoothies; two find the tight lid hard to remove.
cosori-dual-blaze-6-8-qt: Praised for two heating elements that cook evenly and fast; a smaller group report coatings wearing.
cosori-pro-le-5-qt: Liked as compact, quick and easy to clean; some find the basket small for bigger batches.
cosori-turboblaze-6-qt: Liked as easy to clean, quick and fairly quiet; food cooks hot, so times often need trimming.
instant-pot-duo: Valued as a durable, no-fuss pressure cooker that lasts for years; complaints are scattered.
instant-pot-duo-crisp: Liked for pressure cooking and air frying in one pot; many find the air fryer small and awkward.
instant-pot-pro: Liked for the handled pot, better sauté and extra settings; a good number report reliability problems.
instant-pot-pro-crisp: Liked as easy to use, with a handy air fryer lid; some find the air fryer side small and uneven.
instant-vortex-6-qt: Praised as simple and reliable, used daily for years; a burnt plastic smell is the main downside.
instant-vortex-plus-6-qt: Praised for crisping fries, nuggets and burgers well; a plastic smell on first use is the main complaint.
kitchenaid-heavy-duty-5-2-l-bowl-lift-st: Praised as sturdy and strong with little bouncing; a noticeable group report new units dying.
ninja-air-fryer-af101: Praised as simple, sturdy and good value; some find grease around the heating element hard to clean.
ninja-crispi-fn101: Loved for easy cleaning, with dishwasher-safe glass bowls; some find air frying weaker.
ninja-crispi-pro-as101: Loved for easy cleaning and watching food as it cooks; a few report undercooked food.
ninja-flip-toaster-oven-sp151: Loved for flipping up out of the way and heating fast; cleaning around the elements is the main gripe.
ninja-foodi-digital-air-fry-oven-sp101: Liked for fast heating, simple controls and a flip-up design; cleaning is the main complaint.
ninja-foodi-flexbasket-dz071: Loved for its flexible layout of one big drawer or two zones; few real complaints.
ninja-foodi-max-dual-zone-smart-cook-af4: Liked for the dual baskets, sync finish and meat probe; a couple report it failing early.
philips-airfryer-4000-series-stacked-dua: Liked for a compact stacked design and viewing windows; few real complaints.
philips-airfryer-5000-series-dual-basket: Loved for the steam option and easy cleaning; few real complaints.
typhur-dome: Praised for an easy-clean ceramic basket, quiet running and crispy results; some find it too low.
typhur-dome-2: Praised for even, crispy results across a wide tray and easy cleaning; some find the footprint large.
vitamix-5200: Praised as a tough, simple blender that often lasts a decade or more; it is loud.
vitamix-5300: Known as a long-lasting workhorse that blends very smooth; some find the noise a drawback.
vitamix-alta-pro: Liked as powerful, with smooth results and handy presets; some report a burning plastic smell.
vitamix-ascent-a2500: Liked for easy presets, smooth results and a solid feel; a good number report stalling blends.
vitamix-ascent-a3500: Praised as powerful, with very smooth smoothies and easy presets; some report detection problems.
vitamix-ascent-x2: Liked for its physical knob, useful presets and smooth blends; some find it loud.
vitamix-explorian-e310: Valued as good value for smooth smoothies in a narrow container; it is loud.
vitamix-professional-series-750: Praised as powerful and well built, often running for ten years; it is loud.
vitamix-venturist-v1200: Liked as a good-value Vitamix with very smooth smoothies; the self-detect containers sometimes fail.
